## Checklist

- [ ] Targets `develop` (only release PRs target `main`)
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and passing locally
- [ ] Flyway migration added if the schema changed (never edit an applied one)
- [ ] OpenAPI docs updated if an endpoint changed
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files or keys in the diff
- [ ] Input is validated and errors go through the global handler
